scope: OPC and LED shared communication foundation
principles: Keep SIP, RTP, SFU forwarding, IM fanout, and remote relay hot paths free of synchronous database, object storage, analytics, and AI calls.
Prefer fewer vertically efficient services until measured load requires a distributed form.
Every added component needs a concrete problem, an owner, bounded resources, health and drain semantics, evidence, and a rollback path.
Use protocol and provider boundaries so a component can be replaced without changing LED or OPC business APIs.
A version tag without a resolved commit or an image without a digest is not a production release identity.
